title: Autosense calculates duplicated entries
symptom: Autosense is taking duplicate entries into account for a long period, leading to incorrect autosense values (e.g., 1.85/1.15 instead of 1.0). The issue persists until a forced restart of the phone, after which duplicates are gone, but the problem often returns within a few hours.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. A maintainer notes it is rare and related to some irregularity in bg data, but the exact cause is not identified.
fix: No definitive fix is provided. A forced restart of the phone temporarily clears the duplicates, but the issue recurs. The maintainer suggests testing with version 3.0 and creating a new issue if needed.
evidence_quote: this issue is rare and AAPS recover from it itself usually. So far I was not able to locate the issue because it's rare and not permanent. I found out it's related to some irregularity in bg data
